meta.name: budget-pacing-monitor
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "check pacing", "am I over/under-spending", "is this campaign on track to hit budget", or "why did spend spike/stall mid-flight"; returns a spend-vs-target-curve read, learning-phase status, an over/under-delivery call, and a reallocation trigger. Not for initial budget allocation — use budget-optimizer; not for choosing the bid strategy — use bid-strategy-planner; not for the RQS gate — use ad-account-auditor. 付费广告预算节奏监控/跑量过快过慢/在途配速

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 监控广告预算消耗节奏，发现超支或不足
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理付费广告账户，需要实时掌握预算消耗进度
copy.tagline_en: Monitor ad budget pacing to detect overspend or underspend
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid ad accounts and need real-time budget pacing insights

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析广告活动的实际花费与目标曲线，给出进度判断（正常/超前/落后/停滞）、学习阶段状态、超投或低投提醒，并在偏差超过设定范围时触发预算重新分配建议。
howto.when: 当你询问广告活动是否超支或不足、花费是否按计划进行，或花费突然飙升/停滞时触发。需要你提供广告活动数据（如每日花费、预算、投放日期）。

say.text: 检查广告活动X的进度，日预算200美元，已投放9天，共30天。
say.note: Claude 会计算花费与目标曲线的对比，给出进度判断。

say.text: 这个广告活动已花费30%预算，但时间已过60%，是否低投？
say.note: Claude 会判断是否低投，并建议是否重新分配预算。

say.text: 为什么前两天花费突然飙升？
say.note: Claude 会分析超投原因，如预算上限、出价限制等。

howto.what_en: Claude reads an in-flight campaign's spend against its target curve, returns a pacing verdict (on-track/ahead/behind/stalled), learning-phase status, over/under-delivery call, and a reallocation trigger when the gap exceeds a stated band.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about campaign pacing, over/under-spending, or spend spikes/stalls. Requires campaign data (daily spend, budget, flight window).

say_en.text: Check pacing on Campaign X, daily budget $200, 9 days into a 30-day flight.
say_en.note: Claude compares spend to target curve and gives a verdict.

say_en.text: This campaign spent 30% of budget with 60% of flight gone, is it under-delivering?
say_en.note: Claude assesses under-delivery and suggests reallocation if needed.

say_en.text: Why did spend spike two days ago?
say_en.note: Claude identifies the driver (e.g., cap-limited, bid-throttled).
